title: Machine-checked solutions of open problems from Formal Conjectures and the IQOQI Open Quantum Problems
description: Lean 4 proofs, checked against the unmodified statements of Google DeepMind's Formal Conjectures repository, of open problems from that repository and from the IQOQI Vienna Open Quantum Problems list. First entry: OEIS A051903, Thomas Ordowski's questions (**) and (***) from 2019. There is no odd n with a(n) > 1 and b^n = b^a(n) mod n for all b (proof by the lifting-the-exponent lemma). There is an odd n with a(n) > 1 and 2^n = 2^a(n) mod n, namely n = 7*631*881*3511^2*201961 = 9687963167864344937, built on the Wieferich prime 3511. Each folder contains the Lean proofs, an independent check, verification logs and the record of the prior-work search.
